definitions: To offer something for consideration, acceptance, or display.
To formally introduce a person to another or to a group.
To give a gift or award.
To show or offer oneself for a particular purpose or at a particular place.
To cause something to appear or be available.
examples: The committee will present its findings tomorrow.
He was presented to the Queen.
They presented her with a bouquet of flowers.
All employees must present for duty by 9 AM.
The problem presents a new challenge.
